meta.description:
A dockside chandlery arranged around rope, sailcloth, and tarred timber, with a practical retail front leading into storage and workshop spaces. The rear workshop opens toward a
    raised-feeling sail loft, giving the building a strong working-harbor character.

layout.description:

rooms.name: The Dockside Counter
rooms.style: A bustling chandlery shop with stout timber counters, brass fittings, bundled supplies, and walls crowded with hooks, lamps, canvas, and maritime tools.

rooms.name: The Rope Gallery
rooms.style: A long rope-handling room with coils, hanging hawsers, pulley forms, rough posts, and thick braided assemblies arranged like a working rigging store.

rooms.name: The Oiled Canvas Store
rooms.style: A cool, dim store for rolled sailcloth and tarpaulins, with broad canvas-like forms, wooden racks, waxed surfaces, and the heavy scent of oil and weatherproofing.
